title: Apple Crumble
method: Cut apples into quarters, peel, core, and chop into chunks. Transfer into a pie dish.
Add 6 tablespoons of water, a large pinch of ground cinnamon, and 1 tablespoon of caster sugar over the apples.
Add the flour to a mixing bowl. Cut the butter into small cubes and add to the bowl.
Stir and cut the butter into the flour using a blunt knife until each piece is coated.
Rub the butter into the flour using your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Mix in the light soft brown sugar using your fingers.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the fruit in the pie dish.
Bake in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes until the crumble topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbling.
